text: 539. After the distillation of the turpentine, there re- manus in the fill a brittle refinous folblance, of a yellow colour, called _yellow refin [L.]_.

parsed.faithful: 539. After the distillation of the turpentine, there remains in the still a brittle resinous substance, of a yellow colour, called yellow resin [L.].
